market_outlook.short_term: High volatility expected. Oil above $100 and 60%+ rate hike odds create a stagflationary backdrop. Dow 3-day slide likely to extend unless Iran de-escalates. Bond yields may pause at multiyear highs but upside risk remains. Broadband and consumer sectors face continued pressure. Crypto remains range-bound ahead of inflation data.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict resolves within 3-6 months, oil normalizes and rate pressure eases. AI capex cycle (Google $15B, OpenAI) supports tech leadership in 2027. Nuclear energy policy shift creates multi-year tailwind. Trade war with Canada may persist 12+ months, pressuring cross-border supply chains. Consumer squeeze from insurance and energy may moderate as inflation peaks.
